Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The agent misinterpreted the Science Advances abstract, using an approximate age of ~150,000 years instead of the minimum “at least” age (≥142,000 years) and produced 150 as the thousands figure. According to Rule 2, this is a misreading of source data, directly introducing the incorrect number that downstream steps merely propagated. While later steps finalized the error, the decisive mistake occurred here.
